# External data

Place the Kaggle **NBA Database** SQLite file here as `nba.sqlite`:

- Dataset: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/wyattowalsh/basketball
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike apply to derived work)
- Download manually with your Kaggle account (this project performs no
  automated collection), then export season stats into
  `data/raw/player_season_stats.csv` using the template in `data/raw/`.
